resources.string: While patrolling on a simulated walk, this app writes steps and distance to Health Connect based on the simulated distance, so Pikmin Bloom can read the steps to grow seedlings. The data is only written to Health Connect on your own phone and is never uploaded to any server.
You can paste coordinates or a link from Google Maps
Can\'t read these coordinates. Use \"latitude, longitude\", e.g. 35.6812, 139.7671

If you stop right away, the game sees you back at your real location the next second, which looks like a teleport. It\'s better to tap \"Go home\" and walk back first; the mock location turns off automatically once you get home.
Replace the current Big Flower list?
Importing replaces your current Big Flowers (%1$d). This can\'t be undone.
No Big Flowers yet. Long-press the map to add one.
The \"Precise location\" permission is needed to record your starting point (home) and to return to your real location at the end.
Notifications show the patrol status and \"Arrived at Big Flower\" alerts. You can still patrol without them.
Go to Settings → Additional settings → Developer options → Select mock location app, choose \"Pikmin Bloom GPS\", then come back.
First long-press the map to add at least one Big Flower.
Health Connect is unavailable, so no steps will be written. Start the patrol anyway?
Read and write access to steps and distance is needed so Pikmin Bloom can read the steps from your patrol.
No location permission, can\'t start patrol
Can\'t get your current real location

This app mocks your GPS location and writes steps to Health Connect.

Niantic's Terms of Service explicitly prohibit tampering with location and steps. Accounts that break them may get a warning under the three-strike policy, a 7-day suspension, or even a permanent ban.

By using this app, you understand and accept all the risk of action against your account. The author takes no responsibility.
I understand and accept the risk
Arrived at \"%1$s\". In the game, tap the Big Flower and swipe down to collect Nectar.
Back at your real location. Mock location turned off.
Complete these items in order so patrols work properly. Everything is rechecked automatically when you come back to this page.

\"Precise location\" is needed to record your real location (home) at the start and to hand back smoothly to the real GPS after going home. We recommend setting this app\'s location permission to \"Allow all the time\" in system settings.
Patrol runs as a foreground service, which needs an ongoing notification. When you reach a Big Flower, a notification with vibration also reminds you to collect Nectar.
3. Developer options → Select mock location app

HyperOS / Xiaomi: Settings → About phone → All specs → tap \"OS version\" 7 times to turn on Developer options. Then go to Settings → Additional settings → Developer options → Select mock location app → choose \"Pikmin Bloom GPS\".
The distance walked on patrol is converted to steps and written to Health Connect, so Pikmin Bloom can use them to grow seedlings. Read and write access to steps and distance is needed.
Tip: in Health Connect → Data sources and priority, move this app to the top so the game uses its steps first.
Health Connect isn\'t available on this device right now

HyperOS power saving kills foreground services. Exclude this app from battery optimization, then in Settings → Apps → Pikmin Bloom GPS → Battery saver choose \"No restrictions\", and also turn on \"Autostart\".
6. Floating bar permission (display over other apps)
Lets the floating bar appear over Pikmin Bloom, so you can pause / go home / stop the patrol without switching back to this app.

HyperOS / Xiaomi: besides \"Display over other apps\", also go to Settings → Apps → Pikmin Bloom GPS → Permissions and turn on \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\", or the floating bar won\'t appear over the game.
7. Pikmin Bloom in-game settings (do it yourself)

Pikmin Bloom: Settings → Privacy & Steps → Steps → choose Health Connect → Open settings → allow reading steps → Add access → allow \"Access data in the background\".\nPhone settings → Apps → Pikmin Bloom → Permissions → Location → Allow all the time.
Pikmin Bloom not found. Please install it first.
Couldn\'t find a system settings screen to open
Circle the Big Flower after arriving
On: after reaching a Big Flower, walk back and forth within 40 m to plant flowers (to help it bloom faster). Off: just pass the Big Flower and head straight to the next one.

This app has written %1$d steps, but today\'s Health Connect total is only %2$d steps. That means this app isn\'t in the \"Data sources\" list, so the game can\'t read these steps.
Go to Health Connect → \"Manage data\" → \"Data sources and priority\" → \"Add data source\" → choose \"Pikmin Bloom GPS\".
Go and stay there: ask how to travel when farther than (km)
From %1$s km on foot, asks first whether to walk (writes steps) or take a vehicle (no steps). Enter 0 to never ask
Vehicles never count steps. The game stops planting flowers above about 15–20 km/h; below that, it still plants. Range 5–1200 km/h. Changes during a patrol apply the next second.
Please enter a number from %1$d to %2$d
When off, only the location is mocked and no steps are written

Default 18 km/h, the most stable in testing. At 19–20 km/h, if your phone overheats and stutters, it may jump a whole stretch the moment it recovers, and the game may think you\'re in a car. Max 20 km/h, your choice.
Enter a positive whole number, or leave it empty for no limit
Delete steps this app wrote today
Only deletes records written by this app; your phone\'s own steps aren\'t affected
This deletes the step and distance records this app wrote to Health Connect today. Are you sure?
Delete failed (Health Connect unavailable or no permission)
Notify on arrival at a Big Flower
Shows a small floating window over Pikmin Bloom so you can pause / go home / stop right there. Needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.

The floating bar needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.\nOn HyperOS / Xiaomi, also turn on \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\", or the floating bar won\'t appear over the game. Go to settings now?
Floating bar shown (long-press the flower to pin / unpin)
Pinned: stays visible after the patrol ends
Unpinned: hides automatically after the patrol ends
